perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

notes: Speedrunner's Shopping List: Double slug (good for: all S21 raids and dungeons)

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Pinpoint Slug(65) Arc Shotgun Special Ammo. "Do you have a FILO? If not this is your chance, if you do then don’t bother in PvE with Gunnora’s Axe. It serves its purpose as a quick damage alternative."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range. Pinpoint Slug() Arc Shotgun Special Ammo. "In PvP you can roll with two different rolls, Threat Detector and Opening Shot are going to be the best perks to look for. Slickdraw makes a return similar to Bite of the Fox for being able to invest entirely into range. Either through Iron Reach and any range boosting mag perk, or Opening Shot. Range Masterwork is helpful but not required. Keep an eye out for this shotgun if you like pinpoint slug shotguns."

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): Recommended MW: Range. Pinpoint Slug() Arc Shotgun Special Ammo. "In PvP you can roll with two different rolls, Threat Detector and Opening Shot are going to be the best perks to look for. Slickdraw makes a return similar to Bite of the Fox for being able to invest entirely into range. Either through Iron Reach and any range boosting mag perk, or Opening Shot. Range Masterwork is helpful but not required. Keep an eye out for this shotgun if you like pinpoint slug shotguns."

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Did you never get a good rolled FILO? Well this is your chance, Gunnora's Axe is a perfect replacement or alternative. Auto-loading holster and vorpal weapon make this an identical roll to FILO." Recommended MW - Stability.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "With the current state of slug shotguns, you do want to go for as much range as possible while maintaining as high of handling as possible. Fluted barrel or hammer-forged rifling are your best options for barrels. Accurized is the only choice as for whatever reason Gunnora’s Axe doesn’t get access to assault mag. Threat detector and opening shot are the S tier combo to get. Iron reach and moving target are decent substitutes as long as you have the handling to back it up." Recommended MW - Range.
